name: Knockout artboard
description: Drag vector shapes onto an artboard, hold to subtract them from the fill, then scroll to rinse the sheet down to single-colour artwork with clean holes.

copy.default: Drag the shapes onto the artboard, then hold to subtract them from the fill. Click a shape to turn it, or focus one and use the arrow keys.

copyTouch.default: Drag the shapes onto the artboard, then hold to subtract them from the fill. Tap a shape to turn it, or focus one and use the arrow keys.

shapeHint.default: Drag to move, arrow keys nudge, R turns it.

canvasLabel.default: An artboard filled with a tinted fill. Shapes you place are subtracted from it, and the rinse leaves single-colour artwork.

holdLabel.default: Hold to subtract the shapes from the fill

capB.default: the shapes you placed stay behind as holes.

finBodyA.default: Pathfinder does this on curves in

finBodyB.default: : your shapes are subtracted from the fill, and what remains is single-colour artwork. Save it as a 1600 by 2000 PNG, or start another sheet.

autoNote.default: With nothing held, the sheet was given 9 seconds of subtraction.

finNote.default: , which exports SVG, PDF, EPS, DXF, PNG, JPEG and WebP.

propDocs.shapes: Array of {name, label, op, vw, vh, gs, desk, mob, d} in tray order. d lists the path data strings of the shape, vw and vh are its view box size, gs the scale of its path group, op the cut strength, desk and mob the start [x, y, turn, size] on wide and narrow screens (x and y in artboard heights from the artboard centre, turn in degrees).
propDocs.shapesMore: Further shapes in the same format, placed after the first list. The model limits one json prop to 64 KiB, so the shape set is split over two props.
propDocs.holdText: Use a line break to split the label over two lines.
propDocs.footRight: {n} is replaced by the seconds held, as two digits.

fallback: Without 2D canvas the artboard stays blank; with reduced motion the story snaps between its start, rinse and finished states as the page scrolls, and every control stays usable.
